name: Dr Richard Grainger
subtitle: Notes on composite materials
title: Dr Richard Grainger — Notes on materials technology
description: Writing on composites, ceramics and materials innovation; how the materials work and how they're made, and perspectives on where the field is heading.
author: Dr Richard Grainger
heroStatement: Richard writes about ceramics, composites and the long road from lab bench to flight.
heroSub: Co-founder and CTO of HTMS Composites. Chartered engineer, materials scientist, and keen student of the things that stop good inventions reaching the world.
libraryLede: A short shelf of books that changed how I think about engineering, invention and the people who do it. Not everything I've read, just the ones I find myself recommending.
